subjects.name: Right Wing News and Freedom Daily network

summary: Wounded US Air Force veteran Brian Kolfage ran a network of fake news Facebook pages, then in 2018-2019 turned a viral GoFundMe for Trump's border wall into his own unaccountable nonprofit, We Build the Wall.

evidence.note: Media Matters study ties a meme-page network to Kolfage's Right Wing News
Kolfage's 2004 rocket injury at an Iraq air base and how he frames it
earlier 2015 veteran-mentorship GoFundMe; hospitals never heard of it
ex-writers say he ordered fabricated and doctored stories for clicks
began hiring page writers in 2016; Freedom Daily cut off in 2018
December 2018 wall fundraiser launched with a one billion dollar goal
January 2019 pivot: donors asked to opt in to a private wall nonprofit
501(c)(4) status means little donor disclosure and wide spending latitude
board includes Prince, Kobach, Tancredo and Sheriff Clarke

notes: Format current-affairs: a single episode on a fundraiser still in progress at release, built on recent reporting; no childhood coverage, so deep-dive's lifetime rule does not fit. Reviewer may prefer deep-dive. Kolfage birth year 1982 from general knowledge. His 2020 fraud indictment postdates the episode. fascism-far-right reflects the far-right pages and racist content, a modest segment.
